name: Polygons
description: You are given two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$. You need to construct $$$k$$$ regular polygons having same circumcircle , with distinct number of sides $$$l$$$ between $$$3$$$ and $$$n$$$. Illustration for the first example. You can rotate them to minimize the total number of distinct points on the circle. Find the minimum number of such points.
input_specification: The only line of input contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$3 \le n \le 10^{6}$$$, $$$1 \le k \le n-2$$$), the maximum number of sides of a polygon and the number of polygons to construct, respectively.
output_specification: Print a single integer — the minimum number of points required for $$$k$$$ polygons.
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
